theorems.name: Submission.doraggt_graph_blowup_rescaling
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (a : Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (v : Euclid n) (r : ℝ), r ≠ 0 → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap (a + ι v + ι' (f v)) r '' Set.range (fun u => a + ι u + ι' (f u)) = Set.range (fun w => ι w + ι' (r⁻¹ • (f (v + r • w) - f v))) ∧ ∀ w : Euclid n, fderiv ℝ (fun w' => r⁻¹ • (f (v + r • w') - f v)) w = fderiv ℝ f (v + r • w)
